proposal_quality_units.rationale: Leukemoid reaction is a concrete diagnosable reactive leukocytosis syndrome, not a myeloid neoplasm with increased blasts. The two same-context proposals use the identical diagnostic concept.
Leukemoid reaction is a concrete reactive syndrome rather than a chronic myeloproliferative neoplasm. The two same-context proposals are exact concept duplicates.
Leukemoid reaction is diagnosable but is not itself an inflammatory or autoimmune disorder, even though inflammation can trigger it. The two same-context proposals denote the same diagnosis.

Multiple myeloma is a specific plasma-cell neoplasm. In this context it belongs within the broad lymphoid-neoplasm taxonomy rather than the residual Other branch, and no baseline or proposal is equivalent to multiple myeloma.

Bronchiectasis is a specific chronic structural airway disease, not a respiratory infection. It is neither synonymous with the listed infections nor with primary ciliary dyskinesia or Kartagener syndrome.
Malignancy-associated hypercalcemia is a concrete paraneoplastic/metabolic complication and fits Neoplastic/Paraneoplastic Syndrome. None of the listed individual cancers is an equivalent diagnosis.

Volvulus is a specific mechanical gastrointestinal obstruction and fits this parent. The two other same-context volvulus proposals are exact diagnostic duplicates; the broader obstruction baselines are not true synonyms.
Hypertension is a concrete diagnosis but is not a gastrointestinal obstruction. No baseline or same-context proposal denotes hypertension.
Volvulus is a mechanical torsion causing obstruction, not a primary gastrointestinal motility disorder. The two same-context volvulus proposals are exact duplicates.
Mesenteric ischemia is a specific vascular abdominal disorder, not a gastrointestinal motility disorder. The two other same-context proposals name the identical condition.
Mesenteric ischemia is a vascular ischemic condition rather than inflammatory bowel disease. The two other same-context proposals are exact concept duplicates.
Volvulus is specific but belongs under Gastrointestinal Obstruction, so the residual Other placement is invalid. The two other same-context proposals denote the same diagnosis.
Mesenteric ischemia is specific but belongs under the available Vascular Disorder branch, not residual Other. The two other same-context proposals denote the same diagnosis.
Croup is a specific infectious upper-airway disease and fits Upper Respiratory Infection. The three other same-context croup proposals are exact duplicates.
Croup primarily affects the larynx and trachea as an upper-airway illness, not a lower respiratory infection. The three other same-context croup proposals are exact duplicates.
Croup is a specific cause of acute upper-airway narrowing and therefore fits Airway Compromise. The three other same-context croup proposals are exact duplicates.
Peritonsillar abscess is a specific deep oropharyngeal infection that can produce clinically important airway compromise. No baseline or same-context proposal is equivalent to it.
Croup is infectious, but it belongs to the explicit Upper Respiratory Infection branch rather than the residual Other Infectious Causes branch. The three other croup proposals are exact duplicates.

Prosthetic valve endocarditis is a specific, clinically meaningful subtype of infective endocarditis and fits the parent. It is not synonymous with the baseline temporal, complication, or culture-status subtypes.
Bronchiectasis is a specific chronic structural bronchial disease, not a respiratory infection. The genetic syndromes in the baseline can cause bronchiectasis but are not equivalent diagnoses.

Multiple myeloma is a specific plasma-cell neoplasm. It does not fit the increased-blast, chronic myeloproliferative, or reactive-leukocytosis branches in this context, so residual Other is valid; no listed concept is equivalent.

Malignancy-associated hypercalcemia is a specific neoplastic/paraneoplastic complication rather than a primary endocrine disorder. Multiple myeloma and the other baseline neoplasms are causes, not synonyms.
Hypertension is a specific diagnosis but is unrelated to membership in Gastrointestinal Obstruction. No baseline or same-context proposal is equivalent.

Mesenteric ischemia is a specific vascular disorder, not a gastrointestinal motility disorder. The same-context B:B3:08 proposal denotes the identical diagnosis; the broad vascular baseline is not a true synonym.
Mesenteric ischemia is vascular rather than inflammatory bowel disease. The same-context B:B2:07 proposal is an exact duplicate, while broad vascular categories are not equivalent diagnoses.

Peritonitis is a concrete diagnosable inflammatory or infectious peritoneal condition. None of the named non-Other parents captures it directly in this context, and no baseline or proposal is synonymous.

Croup is a specific upper-airway disease capable of causing clinically significant airway compromise. It is not synonymous with epiglottitis, foreign-body aspiration, angioedema, or a generic residual category.

Prosthetic valve endocarditis is a specific meaningful subtype of infective endocarditis and fits this parent. The same-context B:B3:02 proposal names the identical diagnosis; baseline endocarditis subtypes are not true synonyms.

Prosthetic valve endocarditis is an infectious endocardial/valvular infection and belongs under Infective Endocarditis, not the structural Cardiac Valve Disorder branch. B:B1:02 is the same diagnosis.
Bronchiectasis is a specific chronic structural airway disease rather than a respiratory infection. Primary ciliary dyskinesia and Kartagener syndrome may cause it but are not equivalent concepts.

Malignancy-associated hypercalcemia is a specific paraneoplastic complication, not a primary endocrine disorder. Multiple myeloma with hypercalcemia is a meaningful etiologic subtype, not an equivalent general diagnosis.

Volvulus is a specific mechanical gastrointestinal obstruction and fits this parent. The two other same-context volvulus proposals are exact duplicates; broader obstruction diagnoses are not true synonyms.
Hypertension is a concrete diagnosis but does not belong under Gastrointestinal Obstruction. No baseline or same-context proposal denotes the same diagnosis.
Volvulus is a mechanical torsion causing obstruction rather than a primary motility disorder. The two other same-context volvulus proposals denote the identical diagnosis.
Mesenteric ischemia is a specific vascular ischemic disorder, not a gastrointestinal motility disorder. Atherosclerotic vascular disease is only one possible etiology and is not a true synonym.
Volvulus is an obstructive mechanical disease, not inflammatory bowel disease. The two other same-context proposals are exact concept duplicates.
Croup is a specific acute upper-airway disease that can directly cause airway compromise. It is distinct from the listed baseline causes and generic residual category.

Prosthetic valve endocarditis is a specific clinically meaningful subtype of infective endocarditis. The baseline temporal, complication, and culture-status categories overlap on other axes but are not true synonyms.

Malignant hyperthermia is a specific pharmacogenetic hypermetabolic syndrome triggered by anesthetic exposure and fits Toxic/Metabolic Disorder. It is distinct from the listed toxidromes and generic residual category.
